name: 96k-health-apis-for-agents
title: Health API endpoints
description: 96,866 health API endpoints that passed a keyless data call, tested 11–15 Nov 2026 (IST). On the date in `last_tested` (IST), one GET to the URL, sent with no key, returned HTTP 2xx and a non-empty data body. HTML pages and empty results did not pass. The `format` column records what came back. This is a test result for that date, not a promise that the URL answers today. Licences, terms, rate limits, accuracy and freshness were not reviewed. Endpoints are URLs, not separate APIs; many share one service.
